ops.entry: WHEN a plan-time reader's repairs each surface one narrower failure in the same mechanism DO ask pm to state that family as a class contract with an exhaustive state enumeration before signature — instance repairs reach validate as instances, and each round there surfaces one more member.
ops.why: My plan-run escalation read successive journal-replay races as over-specified mechanism only; signature expected one rework round, validate then spent four with one class member per round until a ruling enumerated the class exhaustively.
